items.title: GitLab Patches Multiple Vulnerabilities That Enables DoS and Cross-site Scripting Attacks
items.description: A critical security update has been released for both the Community Edition (CE) and Enterprise Edition (EE) to address multiple high-severity vulnerabilities. The patches, available in versions 18.8.4, 18.7.4, and 18.6.6, fix flaws that could allow attackers to crash servers, steal data, or hijack user sessions. items.title: Windows Notepad Vulnerability Allows Attackers to Execute Code Remotely
items.description: Microsoft has patched a critical remote code execution (RCE) flaw in the Windows Notepad app, tracked as CVE-2026-20841, which could let attackers run malicious code on victims’ machines. items.title: Windows Remote Desktop Services 0-Day Vulnerability Exploited in the Wild to Escalate Privileges
items.description: Microsoft has patched CVE-2026-21533, a zero-day elevation of privilege vulnerability in Windows Remote Desktop Services (RDS) that attackers are exploiting in the wild to gain SYSTEM-level access.
